name: DUAL32_FIXED512_EXPLICIT_INTERACTION_FEATURE_COMPARISON
why_now: Previous regularized model had no joint MAE/RMSE advantage; root-only analysis found effects concentrated upstream of the saved conflict reference, mixed completion outcomes, and highly redundant feature26 columns.
proposed_features_not_finalized: For A and B separately: signed own-route distance to bound conflict reference, not route_sA minus route_sB as a Euclidean distance.
Whether each vehicle has passed its own reference; this denotes point passage, not full vehicle clearing of an intersection.
Where both distances and speeds are positive: current-speed distance/velocity estimates and signed A-minus-B difference; explicit not-applicable mask otherwise.
Existing kinematics and goal braking margin remain; no post-rollout outcome or future clearance can enter features.
geometry_semantics: Stored minimum_internal_clearance_m at these roots is prior-transition sampled minimum; do not silently reinterpret as instantaneous current clearance. Exact current geometry would require a separately documented reconstruction.
scope: Post-outcome same-route development. Extra context expresses pre-existing route/position relationships; it does not establish new information or guaranteed sufficiency.
method_selection: Feature count/scaling/encoding and model comparison must be fixed before a new run; no fitting under this diagnostic.
evaluation: Keep original full32 primary MAE and RMSE, existing same-group baseline, and source splits. Upstream/non-upstream errors may be reported separately with post-hoc-development status; do not exclude CAP or small-gap states.
limits: No evidence currently authorizes action exclusion, online deployment or single-vehicle experiments.
A constant-speed reference-arrival estimate has a retained counterexample and is not a hard priority rule.
Do not add data automatically if the feature comparison has no advantage.
